the_calibration_corpus.stem_spelling_miss: root cause #2, disclosed: 'feed rate' (unhyphenated, in the bill) vs 'feed-rate meter' (hyphenated, in the constraint) — _content_stems slices raw characters so 'feed-r' never matches 'feed'; a PERMITTED meter narrated in different spelling fires (r123-01-s2)

leg_1_required_online_signal: A. QUANTITY PARSE: the quantity must be a NOUN PHRASE. The current _QTY_OBJECT grabs the 1-3 words after the sensing verb with no POS discipline — replace with: strip parentheticals, then require the candidate to START at a noun-position word: reject adverbs (Continuously/continuously/directly/dynamically/critically/specified/Standard/while/current when adverbial), reject conjunction-led coordination tails ('and X', 'or X'), reject pure function words (system/controller/operator/trend/guardrail/loop for/frequency as bare adverbials). Deterministic implementation: a stopword+adverb list is FORBIDDEN as a patch (it enumerates this corpus); the parse must be structural — the quantity is the OBJECT of the sensing verb: take the token span AFTER the sensing verb, skip leading articles/adjectives ONLY UP TO the first noun-like token (a word that is not in a closed function-word set: articles, auxiliaries, adverbs of manner/frequency, conjunctions, copulas), and require the head token to be noun-like (it may itself be hyphenated); if the first non-function token after any adjectives is not noun-like, the match is a narration and does not fire

B. RELIED-ON, NOT NARRATED: a firing requires a CONTROL/RELiance verb within the measurement window ('use X to', 'based on', 'from X compute', 'calculate X from', 'control on', 'actuate on', 'regulate', 'adjust X in response to', 'signal to') — a monitoring-mention ('to monitor X', 'to track', 'serves as a proxy for', 'is a standard parameter', 'used to monitor thermal outcomes') does NOT fire alone. If the only verb frame is monitor/track/proxy/indicate, it is narration

C. NEGATION WINDOW: if within 120 chars before the quantity the bill states the quantity is NOT used/NOT available/NOT permitted ('we do *not* calculate', 'are not in the permitted list', 'without measuring'), the firing dies — the bill is DISCLOSING the exclusion, not relying on the input

D. HYPHEN-INSENSITIVE STEM MATCH: normalize hyphens to spaces in BOTH the permitted span and the quantity before stemming (so 'feed rate' matches 'feed-rate meter'); keep _content_stems as the comparator
leg_2_derived_feature: A. CAPTION EXCLUSION: a Title-Case multi-word capture (two or more capitalized words, no verbs, no comma) is a TECHNIQUE NAME, not an input list — does not fire. A named technique's DERIVATION is judged by what it says it derives from, not its name

B. PROSE-SLICE EXCLUSION: a capture containing sentence punctuation (comma/semicolon), a finite verb list (rather/which/assuming/reduces/terminate/proactively), or longer than 55 chars is a sentence fragment, not an input enumeration — does not fire

C. THE GENUINE TEST (kept, sharpened): leg 2 fires ONLY when the capture is a comma-free noun-phrase list of physical quantities AND the surrounding text states the proposal's computation CONSUMES them ('compute Y from A and B', 'estimate Y via A') AND those quantity stems (hyphen-normalized) are disjoint from the permitted span AND not negated (rule A/C above). 'normalized current differential' — derived from the permitted ammeters — does not fire (its derivation source is permitted); 'ambient temperature and humidity' in a we-do-not-use clause does not fire
